title: THE BEST GUIDE IN MY LIFE OF 84 YEARS
text:
Xavier- the most incredible guide I have encountered in 84 years!
I never imagined I would love this man and what he shared with my wife and I.  I cannot give him enough praise. OMG.  I feel blessed to have so friggin fortunate to learn from an expert.  

Only one regret. I should have recorded every second of his bringing Gaudí to life.  Then I could listen, hear his wisdom, and get my fix on Gaudi whenever my spirits wanted to soar.  I love thisan and the gift he gave to my wife and I.
author: N1299BLstephens
